---
title: "Choosing a dataset"
---

Tick off each item as you go. Your progress is saved in your browser.

```{=html}
<div class="progress-wrap">
  <span id="progress-text">0 / 20 complete</span>
  <button id="reset-btn" type="button">Reset</button>
  <div class="progress-bar-outer"><div class="progress-bar-inner" id="progress-bar"></div></div>
</div>
```

<!--
  HOW TO EDIT
  - Section name: change the "## A: ..." line.
  - Big heading of an item: the text inside [ ]{.item-title}
  - Explanation: the normal text underneath. You can use markdown here,
    including citations like [@Heaney2025] (key must match references file exactly).
  - Keep each item wrapped in  ::: {.check-item}  ...  :::
  - The checkboxes are added automatically by the script at the bottom.
-->

## References

::: {#refs}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('.check-item');
  var bar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
  var text = document.getElementById('progress-text');
  var KEY = 'dataset-checklist-v2';

  function load() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function save(state) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Add a checkbox to every item and wrap the existing content
  var boxes = [];
  items.forEach(function (item) {
    var body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'item-body';
    while (item.firstChild) body.appendChild(item.firstChild);

    var box = document.createElement('input');
    box.type = 'checkbox';
    box.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Mark as done');

    item.appendChild(box);
    item.appendChild(body);
    boxes.push(box);

    // Clicking anywhere on the item toggles it (but not links, e.g. citations)
    item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest('a')) return;
      if (e.target !== box) { box.checked = !box.checked; }
      update();
    });
  });

  function update() {
    var done = 0, state = {};
    boxes.forEach(function (b, i) {
      if (b.checked) done++;
      state[i] = b.checked;
    });
    save(state);
    bar.style.width = (done / boxes.length * 100) + '%';
    text.textContent = done + ' / ' + boxes.length + ' complete';
  }

  var saved = load();
  boxes.forEach(function (b, i) { b.checked = !!saved[i]; });

  document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    boxes.forEach(function (b) { b.checked = false; });
    update();
  });
  update();
})();
</script>
```
